findings.title: Machine-readable historical outcome can be mistaken for adjudicated approval
findings.evidence: Both index entries have effectiveOutcome=approved. The same round explicitly rejects the core safety statement about canonical tests and the capture spec statement about all supplied tests. The final narrative correctly withholds affected unit approval.
findings.impact: A consumer that counts effectiveOutcome values can wrongly count the two rejected statements as accepted evidence, even though the human narrative is qualified.
findings.exactCorrection: Keep historical raw records and index unchanged. Use historical-adjudication-overlay.json to distinguish rawModelOutcome, historicalParserEffectiveOutcome, historicalAdjudication and countsTowardPublishedUnitApproval.
